objective: Implement the smallest truthful Cloud IaC local foundation: metadata-only OpenTofu module registry records, cell topology metadata, GitOps reconciliation evidence, and manifest truth-down with explicit non-claims.

best_practice_sources.evidence_used: Module addresses use namespace/name/system and versioned module records; registry endpoints list versions and return download locations.
A module registry is the native distribution mechanism for modules shared across configurations with module versioning.
Provider lock files and checksums are committed/reviewed for dependency selection evidence; CS-CLOUD-IAC-001 records this as a non-claim because no provider lock evidence exists yet.
GitOps desired state must be declarative, versioned/immutable, pulled automatically, and continuously reconciled.
Argo CD automated sync operates from OutOfSync status and self-heal is explicit; CS-CLOUD-IAC-001 records metadata only, not live controller evidence.
Independent cell replicas reduce the impact of bugs, failed deployments, and overload; CS-CLOUD-IAC-001 encodes cell topology metadata and no default cross-cell traffic in the domain.

implemented_claims: New oya-cloud-iac-domain crate validates metadata-only OpenTofu module releases with exact semantic versions, version-pinned sources, sha256 digests, and evidence refs.
In-memory ModuleRegistry rejects duplicate module versions and resolves published releases.
CellDefinition and CellTopologyPlan validate tenant/cell/region boundaries, require module refs, reject duplicate cells, and forbid default cross-cell traffic in local metadata.
GitOpsEvidence records Argo CD reconciliation metadata against a 40-character commit SHA and rejects secret-like evidence refs.
Cloud IaC manifest now advertises only code-backed crates/capabilities and de-authorizes legacy markdown/IP false greens as implementation evidence.
Local OpenTofu module catalog indexes the six existing skeleton modules under microservices/cloud-iac/tofu/modules and explicitly marks provider resources/tests/signing/live registry as non-claims.
explicit_non_claims: No live OpenTofu private module registry API exists.
No OpenTofu providers mirror, provider dependency lock evidence, tofu init/validate/test/plan/apply evidence, or drift detection runtime exists.
No REST, SDK, worker, provider adapter, Postgres registry adapter, rollback engine, or Argo CD API integration exists for Cloud IaC.
No measured Cloud IaC SLOs, error-budget burn rules, active-active DR, restore drill, sharding execution, live mesh enforcement, or capacity telemetry exist.

findings: The slice deletes broad manifest overclaims rather than preserving 47 missing crate claims; the new domain model is plain value validation with no speculative runtime adapters.
Review finding fixed: source version pins are parsed as exact ref query values instead of substring matches.
OpenTofu module metadata follows namespace/name/system/version discipline and records explicit non-claims for live registry, provider locks, signing, and plan/apply evidence.
Cell metadata forbids default cross-cell traffic and remains a local foundation, not a production/shared-contract unlock claim.

The manifest now points contributors at the small set of implemented crates/files and explicitly labels legacy Markdown/IP files as non-evidence for implementation readiness.
The local module catalog makes the six existing skeleton modules discoverable without pretending they are provider-complete releases.

Validated with cargo test for oya-cloud-iac-domain and oya-check-iac-tier-discipline, clippy with warnings denied, cargo check, rustfmt, JSON/coherence, planning-closure, api-semver, architecture-boundaries, dependency-seam, and scoped honest-claims.
Architect review cleared the local-foundation scope before Oya closeout, with an explicit caveat that this is not a broad shared-contract/fanout unlock.

alternatives_named: Only truth-down the manifest without code
Land a narrow metadata/domain foundation plus manifest/catalog truth-down
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: The narrow metadata/domain foundation moves the Phase 0 Cloud IaC bar forward without faking runtime/SLO/DR/GitOps/OpenTofu evidence or touching broad shared deployment contracts prematurely.
rejected_reasons: A live registry/runtime slice would be too broad and would touch shared contracts before the local foundation was locked.
Manifest-only truth-down would leave no code-backed module/cell/GitOps invariants for downstream slices to build on.

findings: The domain crate rejects secret-like source/evidence strings containing token/password/secret/kubeconfig/private-key/API-key markers and stores metadata only.
No raw provider credentials, kubeconfigs, OpenTofu state, cluster-admin material, or secret payloads are introduced.

F8_performance.regression_baseline: not-applicable: metadata-only validators and static catalogs; no runtime OpenTofu API, worker, hot path, or measured SLO claim introduced
findings: The new crate performs cold-path metadata validation only; no request path, background worker, provider plan/apply loop, or scheduler hot path is introduced.
No performance/SLO claim is made; future runtime GitOps/OpenTofu controllers must add benchmarks or load evidence before claiming latency/throughput behavior.

The slice adds internal control-plane metadata only and explicitly rejects secret-like evidence/source strings; no tenant payload, PHI, PCI, kubeconfig, provider credential, or OpenTofu state is introduced.
Auditability is present through this multispectrum evidence record plus the audit-chain pending/closeout lifecycle rows; regulatory pack updates are not required for this local foundation.

Rollback is delete/restore only: remove the isolated domain crate, workspace/catalog rows, module catalog, and manifest/task truth-down edits; no database migration, live cluster, state backend, or provider apply is touched.
Blast radius is repository-local planning/governance evidence. Downstream runtime/shared-contract fanout remains explicitly blocked until later verified slices.

review_findings_fixed: Exact source ref pin parsing replaces substring source validation and rejects suffix/duplicate ref bypasses.
Strict metadata validation rejects leading-zero SemVer, pathlike tenant ids, uppercase/invalid regions, and pathlike cell ids.
Sharding automation manifest block now represents autosharding as enabled=false/mode=not_claimed_runtime with intended_control_plane only as a future posture.
Evidence bundle now carries change_class_id, freshness_unix, and required CC-2 multispectrum facets F1-F10 for this local infrastructure foundation.
